//tsBuildInfoFile: Inside outDir, not the default spot beside this file, so `rm -rf dist` drops the incremental state along with the outputs it describes. Left outside, a deleted dist plus a surviving .tsbuildinfo makes tsc consider every output current and emit nothing — a build that reports success and produces no .d.ts files. Here it is silent as well as wrong: tsup rewrites the JS, so only the declarations go missing and consumers fail with TS7016 rather than an empty dist.
